title: Learn 진짜 (“really?!”) by singing it 🎵 #learnkorean
caption:
Learn 진짜 (jin-jja) the catchy way — it means “really?!”.
Casual Korean for friends and family. Polite form: 진짜요 (jin-jja-yo).
Clap when the singing stops, then you’re up!
